I will mark this as N/A or weakly present based on inference, but strictly speaking, it is not visually verified. The 'Jaws... when closed' checkpoint was correctly marked untestable. artifact_review: The Router identified a 'structural_collapse' at the jaw-neck connection (Severity 2.0). This is a critical observation. Looking at the image, the lower jaw seems to merge into the neck without a distinct hinge or throat pouch definition, which is anatomically vague. The Router also noted background smearing (Severity 1.5). The Perceptual Quality Auditor found only slight compression artifacts, missing the structural ambiguity. The Topology Auditor gave a high confidence score (0.98), which confirms the object is a single coherent mass, but fails to penalize the internal anatomical mushiness. I agree with the Router's severity for the jaw issue; it disrupts the biological realism. The background foliage artifact is minor and typical for AI, so Severity 1.5 is appropriate.
